purpose: Lists an organization's employees inline and in a searchable sheet.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `findByAttribute`, `AttributeFindResult`, `mapWithConcurrency`, `MAX_PARALLEL_DEREFERENCES`, `typeLocalName` from `lws-vault-sets`; `readRecord` from `lws-records`; `photoRefFromFacts` from `photo-term`; `vaultOriginOf` from `vault-origin-rule`; `partyNameOf`, `personKindNamesOf` from `stakeholder-card-model`; `cardMasterSource`, `readStakeholderCardVocabulary`, `readStoredCardVocabulary` from `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`; `masterKindReader` from `plan-stakeholder-io`; `attributeSpelling` from `term-slots`; `refsOf`, `servedValue`, `resolveEmploymentLinkVocab` and the type `EmploymentLinkVocab` from `org-terms` (since 0.2.0); `idFromResourceUri` from `resource-id`; `CardGroup` from `card-group`; `useDebouncedValue` from `record-picker`; `eventTargetInTopDialog`, `modalIsOpen` from `open-popups`; `subjectSpellings` and `inVault` are the unit's own pure copies (`src/subjectSpellings.ts`);

interface `OrgEmployeesHost` (with `ReadResource`, `RecordFaceProps`) and the context `OrgEmployeesHostContext` with `useOrgEmployeesHost()` are added; `readOrgEmployeesPage(...)` takes the host as its new first argument and the default `defaultDeps` is `defaultDepsOf(host)`, whose `readResources` and `photoReadKeys` are `host.readResources(uris, vaultId)` and `host.photoReadKeys()` with the same arguments, at the same places; `employerAttr` and `employeeKey` call `resolveEmploymentLinkVocab()` of `org-terms`, as the source called its own (0.2.0: in 0.1.0 these were `host.resolveEmploymentLinkVocab()`, a host member that is now removed);
`OrgEmployeeRow` reads `RecordFace` from the host and draws it only when the host gives one (absent: no face is drawn, the name and titles still show and the row still opens the person);
`OrgShortList` reads `useSheetHistory` and `dropStaleSheetEntry` from the host, called at the same places as the source called its own; `useOrgEmployees` passes the host to `readOrgEmployeesPage`;
comments made generic (cycle, step, tester and ruling tags, dates, person names and app names removed); no other code change.

0.2.0: `src/servedValue.ts` (a copy of `orgTerms.ts` lines 47-58) and the host member `resolveEmploymentLinkVocab` are removed; `refsOf`, `servedValue` and the type `EmploymentLinkVocab` are still exported from the entry point, re-exported from `org-terms`.
